title: Aarhus January30 Men in Black march
threshold_50_evidence: Original police action report gives no participant count. Police staffing and later February attendance are not crowd estimates.

start_date.summary: Police body confirms actual18:30 January30 march; S165 alone was advance notice.

end_date.summary: Final speeches around21:00 followed by explicit formal closure; same-day public gathering end, not campaign end.

organizer.summary: Police/press and later movement report identify Men in Black.

demands.summary: Retrospective movement report identifies January30 Aarhus MIB action opposing coronavirus restrictions.

participants.summary: No verified actual crowd count. Pre-event police presence is not attendance.

protester_violence.summary: Fireworks during march lack explicit state target. Attempted rock throw against police reported after formal closure; provisional gathering boundary excludes automatic transfer.

state_response.summary: One arrest after formal closure needs unit attribution; earlier charges are not arrests. In-gathering coded responses remain unknown. Organizers' conditional dissolution warning is not state dispersal.

notes: Police describes relatively peaceful course, but that phrase does not verify every violence/response field. A20-year-old attempted to throw a stone at police after the march ended and was arrested; retain as linked post-closure incident pending episode review, not automatically code into the closed gathering. Three charges during march and one pre-event insult charge are not arrests. Positive organizer contact concerns order, not formal reception of demands.
open_questions: Determine whether post-closure attempted rock throw/arrest belongs to same MM episode; recode both fields together if justified.
